summary: Implemented immutable decision versions, scoped authority, accessible inference and separate closure/evidence-coverage metrics. Root review corrected evidence reuse; 41 focused and 168 total tests pass. Five authored decision slices reproduce, including actor-kind controls.
reviewer: Assigned Codex worker self-review, followed by root operator machine review and regression correction; no human-study reviewer
review_notes: Reviewed actual AE-005 corrected source, tests, artifacts, receipt and limitations before edits; checker, 42 tests and 160-case/four-topology replay passed. Reviewed all five AE-002 decision slices, atomic rejection, source dependence, immutable history, authority scope/revocation/expiry and access/transfer ancestry. Two actual provenance regression failures were repaired and retained. review.md records findings, limits and scoped ledger. ADR-008 remains proposed. Required independent controller validation is pending. Subsequent operator-review.md preserves two further actual failures, evidence-reuse correction, stale-copy boundary test and model v2 regeneration; metrics/options/support categories unchanged. Archived original worker receipt is historical.
limitations: Worker self-review only; no independent domain review, architecture acceptance, human participation/comprehension, empirical calibration, integration or publication is established.

Five tabletop decision slices consume authored observations and policy grants. Payment outcomes, verification execution, trial deployments, belief updates and policy enactment are not implemented by AE-006.

evidence_backed_information_gain is distinct usable declared source-root coverage per question, not bits, calibrated probabilities, independent samples, truth or uncertainty reduction. Quality, stance and source authenticity are trusted metadata.

Cumulative choice ancestry is conservative; exact prior subjects retain observation context. Scope/alternatives are fixed per question. Organizational policy conflicts and actors stale beliefs about permission remain future work.
Single trusted owner with shared store/history is a caller contract; concurrency, hostile mutation, persistence and event reconstruction remain unproven.
The initial red was a missing-module collection failure. Later two actual source-laundering assertion failures and repaired outputs are preserved; no tested control failed after correction.

AE-005 passed at entry. The authorized assumptions update makes only its shared register binding historical; exact entry bytes and all-other-bindings verification are preserved. The actual expected post-edit checker failure is retained.
Shared handoff ledger and ADR register are outside allowed paths; research/experiments/AE-006/review.md records the scoped handoff. No successor or controller launch was executed.

An auxiliary untracked-file whitespace wrapper initially misread git diff --no-index exit 1 as an error. The corrected probe accepts added-file differences only with empty diagnostics; source-review.json preserves both dispositions.

The single permitted git add attempt failed with exit 128: shared Git metadata is read-only. No commit exists; no retry or push was attempted. Launch policy requires worker status failed until controller/operator delivery recovery.

Original worker statements about independent review, test counts and uncommitted delivery are historical. Root machine review supplied the bounded correction; controller delivery retry still required. No human comprehension evidence exists.

predecessor_review.disposition: pass at entry; successor assumptions binding archived

test_method: Focused missing-API red/green then two behavioral regression reds/green; boundary, negative, invariant, immutable-version, access/communication integration and actor-kind controls.
